warnings: Metoclopramide: adult maximum 10 mg up to TDS (30 mg/day) and maximum treatment duration 5 days under current EMA/Irish product information; avoid prolonged repeated use without review.
NCCP 00696 v2 Table 6: the cetuximab steroid and antihistamine also cover paclitaxel on these combined-treatment days. Do not repeat either drug before paclitaxel.
NCCP Table 7 supplies the H2-antagonist component. Its omission requires consultant review; source uncertainty about reaction risk must remain visible.

hn47_carbo_fu_adjuvant.label: 00552 adjuvant carboplatin / fluorouracil
warnings: Dexamethasone may be modified or omitted where the SACT regimen already includes a steroid.
Metoclopramide: adult maximum 10 mg up to TDS (30 mg/day) and maximum treatment duration 5 days under current EMA/Irish product information; avoid prolonged repeated use without review.
This is the adjuvant post-chemoradiotherapy nasopharyngeal regimen: up to three 28-day cycles, not ongoing metastatic treatment.
Carboplatin is on Day 1 and fluorouracil on Days 1–4. Review daily risk and delayed cover in the actual pump prescription.
No routine olanzapine is included in the dedicated NCIS carboplatin AUC≥4 row.
hn47_carbo_fu_adjuvant.evidence_update: Ireland/NCCP V8 classifies carboplatin AUC ≥4 in its high-risk antiemetic branch (NK1 + 5-HT3 + dexamethasone). MASCC/ESMO 2023 uses a special MEC triple regimen at AUC ≥5. SACTCheck follows current NCCP classification for the Irish pathway and shows the international threshold difference for review.
hn47_carbo_fu_adjuvant.clinical_review_status: Draft for clinician/pharmacy completion and authorisation

integration_notes: Merge only these exact keys; preserve all existing plans/selectors and generic rules.

The existing selected-phase branch clears legacy local adjunct prescription items, avoiding automatic nystatin/chlorhexidine or unrelated local proformas.
00696 base risk remains low; the clinician selector distinguishes premedication by visit without relabelling its emetogenic classification as moderate.
The four-day cisplatin plan has intentionally unfilled drug doses. Its available status means the explanatory template exists, not that an executable prescription is complete.
